name: Tufted Titmouse
facts: Call pattern: a loud, whistled "peter-peter-peter" repeated up to a dozen times in a row.
Habitat: deciduous woods, parks and feeders. Nests in old woodpecker holes and lines the nest with hair, sometimes plucked from live animals.
Migration: none. Titmice stay on territory year-round, and their range has pushed steadily north over the past century.
